arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test all binary, octal, hex with signs
tests = [
    ('{:b}', '-100'),
    ('{:b}', '+100'),
    ('{:o}', '-77'),
    ('{:o}', '+77'),
    ('{:x}', '-FF'),
    ('{:x}', '+FF'),
]

for fmt, text in tests:
    result = parse.parse(f'a {fmt} b', f'a {text} b')
    if result:
        print(f'{fmt!r} with {text!r} -> {result.fixed[0]}')
    else:
        print(f'{fmt!r} with {text!r} -> NO MATCH')
"
